FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_MonitorStartStop
VAR_INPUT
    Start_Stop : BOOL;  // Input signal for start/stop
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    ONS_Trig    : BOOL;  // One-shot trigger output
    ON_OFF      : BOOL;   // Output state that toggles
    Rising_ONS  : BOOL;   // Previous state of Start_Stop
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    Previous_Start_Stop : BOOL; // Variable to hold the previous state of Start_Stop
END_VAR

// Initialization
IF NOT Rising_ONS THEN
    Rising_ONS := Start_Stop; // Initialize Rising_ONS with the current state
END_IF

// Detect rising edge
ONS_Trig := (Start_Stop AND NOT Rising_ONS); // Set ONS_Trig on rising edge

// Update ON_OFF state based on ONS_Trig
ON_OFF := ONS_Trig XOR ON_OFF; // Toggle ON_OFF based on ONS_Trig

// Store the current state for the next cycle
Previous_Start_Stop := Start_Stop; // Update previous state for next cycle
Rising_ONS := Start_Stop; // Update Rising_ONS with the current state
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
